title: HOUSE CONFLUENCE MODEL
law: Confluence coordinates unequal lineages through shared addresses, transforms and receipts; it does not require vocabulary collapse.

donors.name: POLY / spatial-computational adapter lineage
contributes: room/cube as projection and interaction testbed rather than kernel
optional signed-axis ports only when physical orientation/mating is consequential
state/lens/transform experiments that preserve address across projections
donors.exclusion: Do not retroactively project signed-port POLY onto the 2018 FURNISHER pitch; do not force cube/port grammar onto arbitrary HOUSE geometry or non-spatial domains.
donors.evidence_class: 2019–2021 exact frozen executable family + 2026 bounded reinterpretation

donors.name: ONE RETURN / SEAM ENGINE
donors.exclusion: HOUSE is a domain pack/adaptor, not evidence that all domains are rooms.

donors.name: SINDER / FURNISHER
contributes: FURNISHER as proposed human-scale pipes/joints/foldable-surface embodiment
POWER / PLANES / PATHS / POINT decomposition from the 2018 source
analog-first/manual fallback as a safety/security property
fixed stock transformed into multiple useful configurations
configuration/room versioning as an intent to be reframed as derivation + measurement + receipt
donors.exclusion: Historical design intent is not proof of structural, electrical, plumbing or load-bearing fitness. Do not revive the startup/platform or literal room-version-control claims inside HOUSE.
donors.evidence_class: 2018 authored product/platform intent + later exact lineage evidence

donors.name: MANDALA / COMPASS / FLOWER lineages
donors.exclusion: Mandala geometry is a lens, not canonical house topology.

donors.name: SEMANTIC PAINTING / movement-path lineage
donors.exclusion: Visual stroke properties must name their encoded variable; no aesthetic mark may masquerade as measurement.

donors.name: HOUSE OS FIELD SYSTEM v1.1 / MARKS
contributes: procurement gated by measured capability gap
donors.exclusion: Do not promote HOS test IDs, a standalone registry, canonical glyph meanings, machine-readable tags as authority, or a new HOUSE subsystem. Recipient-side physical evidence is required.

next_safe_delta: Use TRACE as a playable spatial instrument: author a route, enable tiny-law stacks, observe sediment/edge recurrence, export/replay. Promote only law mechanics that reveal a useful spatial/cognitive decision; keep physical adjacency/occupancy claims reality-gated.

mark_projection_candidate.authority_boundary: MARK may expose an intent or pointer; HOUSE_3 / Home Assistant remains the authority for device truth and actuation.
mark_projection_candidate.promotion_gate: One bounded physical RETURN must show lower ambiguity, faster recovery, safer action, or better state correspondence than the PLAIN/control condition.

donor_briefs.reopen_gate: A named current HOUSE physical friction must exist before transferring one mechanism; compare against PLAIN and require a reversible physical RETURN.
